tracks.title: Where Have All The Good Times Gone

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1973 (UK).

notes.text:
The LP is issued in a white poly lined inner sleeve. The package also includes a replica lyric insert and a plain white (unlined) paper inner sleeve (presumably replicating original inner sleeve).
2015 is printed on centre labels and sleeve, but the LP wasn't released until February 2016.

Title on front sleeve, spine and insert: Pinups
Title on labels: Pin-ups
